evidence.proposition: Under current native FRS102 Section12.17 an eligible hedging instrument is a FVTPL financial instrument with an external party and is not a written option unless offset by or combined with a purchased option and the result is not a net written option under12.17C. Current rules do not impose obsolete swaps/forwards-only, maturity-before-forecast or no-prepayment/extension conditions. Actual economic relationship and documented ineffectiveness causes remain required under12.18.
